title: Just As It Is
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating "suchness" or appreciation for things as they truly are, rather than trying to grasp them intellectually. This is achieved through direct experience and engagement with ordinary experiences, such as nature or everyday objects, which can help awaken us to their true nature. By letting go of our preconceptions and embracing reality as it is, we can develop a deeper sense of awareness and understanding that transcends intellectual comprehension.

Things are thus.

Even my imagining is such.
Even my confusion is such.

Arouse this.

Yeah.
